subject: JNU Precision Analysis Extensions
usage_rule: For every future JNU / Osaka Nikkei / Osaka Micro Nikkei analysis, apply the authoritative framework first, then apply this precision-analysis checklist as mandatory context/risk/path refinement. These extensions do not create additional directional votes unless separately preregistered and validated.

non_negotiable_governance.no_vote_inflation: Correlated evidence must remain within the existing four directional blocks; this file adds precision features, not extra votes.
non_negotiable_governance.unknown_handling: Unavailable evidence is UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE, never guessed NORMAL or favorable.

mandatory_checks: top-4 and top-10 component weight/contribution concentration
Nikkei 225 versus TOPIX divergence/residual when available
mandatory_precision_features.rationale: Nikkei 225 is price-weighted and can be moved disproportionately by a small set of high-weight components; broad participation and concentrated index movement should not receive the same interpretation.
mandatory_precision_features.source: Nikkei Indexes Daily Summary and component weights

mandatory_checks: Nikkei 225 VI versus VIX divergence when both are available
mandatory_precision_features.rationale: Nikkei 225 VI is derived from OSE Nikkei futures/options and is a more direct local implied-volatility measure than relying on VIX alone.

mandatory_checks: policy surprise versus pre-event expectations rather than event-presence only
mandatory_precision_features.rationale: BOJ surprise research finds tightening surprises negatively affect stocks and positively affect JGB yields, with strong 10Y responses in the unconventional-policy era.
mandatory_precision_features.source: CARF/University of Tokyo BOJ high-frequency monetary-policy shock research

mandatory_checks: standardized historical surprise where data rights allow
release timestamp and PIT-safe consensus snapshot
separate Japanese and U.S. macro surprises
mandatory_precision_features.rationale: The information content is the surprise magnitude, not merely whether CPI/NFP/Tankan/GDP is scheduled.
mandatory_precision_features.source: Official release plus PIT-safe consensus provider

mandatory_precision_features.rationale: Nikkei 225 futures literature and Japan FSA granular-data analyses show order imbalance and liquidity conditions are highly informative for intraday price movement and turbulence.
mandatory_precision_features.source: Peer-reviewed Nikkei 225 futures order-imbalance research and Japan FSA Analytical Notes
mandatory_precision_features.availability_rule: Use only with legally authorized L1/L2 or transaction-level data; otherwise UNAVAILABLE.

mandatory_checks: USDJPY movement under active intervention regime
mandatory_precision_features.rationale: Official FX intervention is a distinct policy regime and should not be treated as ordinary USDJPY volatility.
mandatory_precision_features.source: Japan Ministry of Finance Foreign Exchange Intervention Operations

mandatory_precision_features.rationale: The same wick, breakout or order-flow signal has different information value across session and liquidity regimes.
mandatory_precision_features.source: OSE market structure plus internally validated intraday seasonality

mandatory_checks: U.S. Economic Policy Uncertainty level/change when a current rights-clean source is available
whether policy-uncertainty regime coincides with thinner Nikkei futures liquidity, wider spreads or stronger common-market moves
trade/tariff and FX-policy uncertainty when specifically elevated
mandatory_precision_features.rationale: JPX/OSE published a two-part 2026 report specifically on U.S. economic policy uncertainty and Nikkei 225 futures liquidity. Related Japanese research finds higher policy uncertainty is associated with lower liquidity and stronger market-wide stock co-movement. Treat this as a liquidity/evidence-quality regime, not directional alpha.
mandatory_precision_features.source: JPX Futures & Options Report 2026 Aug/Sep; KAKEN/JSRI economic-policy-uncertainty research
mandatory_precision_features.availability_rule: Use only when a current/reproducible EPU measure or clearly sourced policy-uncertainty evidence is available; otherwise UNKNOWN.

lower_wick_research_candidate.adjacency_warning: Mechanically adjacent to a terminal-failed legacy breakout family. Promotion is prohibited unless substantive mechanism independence and a preregistered direct-Japan OOS protocol are demonstrated.

frozen_signal_definition.confirmation: Next trading day trades above signal-day high.

exploratory_proxy_result.dataset: Nikkei 225 spot daily OHLC proxy, 2008-03-17 to 2024-03-15
exploratory_proxy_result.warning: Small sample, multiple-testing/data-snooping exposure, proxy not exact JNU; not a tradable or calibrated probability.

required_next_validation: Freeze the specification; do not tune wick thresholds further.
Use true OSE Nikkei 225 mini individual-contract history with PIT-correct rolls and costs.
Split development and untouched OOS periods before viewing OOS results.
Compare against generic prior-high breakout baseline to estimate incremental edge.
Apply multiple-testing correction and report confidence intervals.
If OSE mini OOS survives, validate exact Micro with individual-month data.
Only after true-target and forward validation may framework role be reconsidered.

future_analysis_output_additions: State whether Nikkei move is broad or concentrated.
State local implied-volatility condition using Nikkei 225 VI when available.
State BOJ/JGB surprise regime when relevant.
State macro surprise magnitude rather than only event name when data is available.
State official FX-intervention regime when relevant.
State session/liquidity regime and normalize intraday signals accordingly.
State order-flow/liquidity evidence only when authorized data exists; otherwise mark unavailable.
Treat long-lower-wick patterns as path evidence only; do not infer bullish edge without confirmation and validation.
State U.S./Japan policy-uncertainty and liquidity regime when materially elevated and supported by current evidence.
downstream_system_note: MARKET_AI_HUB is not the research subject. Only mature, separately validated JNU findings may later be considered for optional downstream integration.
